scope: Conservative adult Coach-review drafts, not medical diagnosis, rehabilitation advice, or autonomous assignment.

evidenceReference.title: ACSM 2026 Position Stand: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults
evidenceReference.application: Goal- and capacity-specific progressive resistance training; preserve exercise specificity, sequencing, volume and recovery context. The limits below are conservative Ravoge product safeguards, not a claim that ACSM prescribes these exact bounds for every person.

applicationSafeguards.duration: 20 minutes through the Client's saved preferred duration; Coach can edit before assignment.
applicationSafeguards.safety: An assigned Coach reviews the full local intake and translates free-text restrictions into structured movement constraints and exercise exclusions. The database filters approved exercise candidates and rechecks current safety at assignment.

privacy: Explicit projection sends goals, experience, frequency, duration, numerical measurements/targets, structured safety flags/tags, equipment enums, and anonymous exercise/reference aliases. No names, free-text notes, email, phone, birth dates, account/gym IDs, source titles or private photo paths are sent.
provider: Existing OpenAI SDK and server-only OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL configuration. OPENAI_WORKOUT_MODEL overrides the existing vision-model configuration or its current pinned default. Responses use store:false, tools:[], strict JSON schema, no conversation history and bounded timeouts. No live web search during generation.
fallback: One initial provider attempt plus one safe retry/repair. Missing configuration, invalid output or provider failures retain/recompute the existing deterministic draft and clearly label fallback. Invalid current safety stops generation rather than bypassing checks.
gymProgramming: Only compatible latest reviewed/published revisions are retrieved; unpublished, unresolved and complex raw imports remain unchanged and excluded. The current fixed-set approval/execution model is preserved; this release does not silently reinterpret EMOMs, percentages, timed stations, supersets or per-side source values.
review: All recommendations remain private drafts. Coach can edit exercises/substitutions, sets, reps, load, RPE, rest, duration, notes and instructions. Only atomic approval creates the existing Client workout assignment.
costControl: At most three new drafts per Coach per minute are eligible for a paid provider attempt; additional requests use deterministic fallback. Local browser QA removes the provider key from its child environment; unit tests inject a mocked SDK. One explicitly authorized production QA generation may call the provider with disposable, deidentified training data.
